verdict.rationale: Scoped API credentials are a fair axis for a payments API platform, so the story applies. The evidence pack never documents restricted or least-privilege keys or per-agent permission scoping. The nearest items are anonymous sandbox API keys and an MCP server for agents; these are adjacent features, not scoped credential issuance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
